versions.title: Rogers and El-Sayed on accusations of ties to Muslim Brotherhood - NBC News

decisions.decision: Retain5NO/.41primary/.31selected; no measured voter shift or verified allegation inferred. The exact NBC article body/byline/publication timestamp and its interview quotes were not retrieved. Context only: the accessible PolitiFact Oct 19 story says prior accusations relied on El-Sayed’s 2011 writing, a 2012 statement supporting the elected President Mohamed Morsi, and his half-sister’s social posts; it says the 2012 statement was not a pledge to support the Brotherhood as a whole. The Oct 25 AP copy separately reports Rogers asked El-Sayed whether he was for America or “terrorist groups overseas” and El-Sayed called the question shameful. These sources do not establish membership or family ties; do not attribute their wording to the inaccessible NBC article. No poll or measured voter effect identified.
